definitions.pass_rate: Fraction of cases where observed blocked/not-blocked matches expected_blocked.
definitions.blocked_cases: Count of cases where the defense pipeline blocked model output.
definitions.review_cases: Count of cases flagged for human review by the pipeline.
definitions.review_match_rate: Among cases with expected_review set, fraction where needs_human_review matches.
definitions.risk_match_rate: Among cases with expected_risk_level set, fraction where detection risk_level matches.
definitions.family_metrics: Per attack_family aggregates: total_cases, blocked_cases, review_cases, pass_rate.
